correctness.rationale: Under the precise stationary-angle assumptions the Markov generator gives stationary Fourier harmonics c1=a mu and c2=b eta; conditional relaxation of velocity deviations is e^{-(D_rot+lambda)s}, so integrated covariance has the stated positive scalar factor for every T>0. The covariance tensor decomposition separates trace and complex second-harmonic deviation z=b eta-a^2 mu^2. The exact unit-circle moment disk and constructive chord laws give all possible z and the four-atom bound. The zero-anisotropy equation proves an if-and-only-if bound, with equality forcing a unique chord and hence each advertised optimal protocol; at t=1/2 it forces a Dirac law. The independent standard-library checker passed 8472 assertions including fixed-angle coefficients and stationary Fourier harmonic sampling. Finite diagnostics do not establish the universal claims without the displayed proof.

originality.rationale: The 2020 Kumar–Sadekar–Basu model and 2024 Baouche–Franosch–Meiners–Kurzthaler treatment provide the fixed-direction-reset diffusion formulas, so these ingredients are not claimed new. The 2024 paper specifies a general angular redraw in its model but explicitly specializes transport calculations to a delta reset law and motivates broadening the reset angle distribution. The present claim characterizes every attainable covariance tensor at any prescribed nonzero drift using an exact complex disk, constructs its boundary and interior with at most four reset angles, and proves a sharp drift–isotropy boundary and unique optimizer switching support geometry at a particular reset-to-rotational diffusion ratio. Inspected relative-angle chiral tumbles and shape-anisotropic deterministic-orientation resets address materially different generators or controls. Full priority cannot be certified by a search and remains subject to independent assessment.
residual_risks: The angular first-two-moment disk is classical, so broader control-theoretic moment literature may already imply the full parameter-dependent synthesis without ABP terminology.
The fixed-angle special case (including the critical ratio at which its two long-time diagonal diffusivities coincide) is directly present or algebraically implied in earlier ABP work.
Full priority assessment of every stochastic active particle design paper is not possible from the inspected subset; independent human scientific verification remains unperformed.

value.rationale: For active particles, net transport and isotropic diffusive spreading are independent experimental objectives that must be co-designed. The exact disk solves the complete physical control-feasibility question at a fixed directed speed; its sharp maximum-speed isotropy constraint, unique two-direction optimizer crossover, constructive four-angle implementation, and validity at every measurement time are substantive structural facts beyond a generic moment substitution or a single optimized numerical parameter. The physically prescribed objective fixes the invariant and explains why this precise result matters.
